title: Tribute to athlete and return of Citadino de Futsal mark the round
seoTitle: Tribute to athlete as Citadino de Futsal returns
subtitle: The resumption of the competition included a minute of silence and four matches played at the Arena gymnasium
excerpt: The Citadino de Futsal returned on Tuesday night (1st) with four matches and a posthumous tribute to athlete Luan, who left his legacy in the sport.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The Citadino de Futsal returned on Tuesday night (1st) with four matches played at the Arena gymnasium, marked by many goals and a posthumous tribute to athlete Luan, who left his legacy in the sport.

The tribute to athlete Luan

Before the start of the matches, the competition organizers and the teams paid tribute to the athlete. In respect for his memory, a minute of silence was observed. The round was marked by this emotional moment, highlighting the importance of the athlete's figure in the context of the tournament.

Serie B Results

On the court, the round featured three Serie B matchups. In the first match of the night, Parceria MS Ceccon got the better of Boca Juniors/Ibirapuitã, winning 4-1. Huerick scored for Boca Juniors/Ibirapuitã. For Parceria MS Ceccon, Magno, João (twice), and Alexandre found the back of the net.

In the second matchup, Promorar thrashed Lazio 7-2. The highlight of the match was Quelisson, who scored four goals. Fernando Jaques also had a great performance with two goals, while Stefen completed the rout. Iago and Vitor Gomes pulled some back for Lazio.

Closing out the Serie B round, Arsenal defeated Athletic 4-2. Elias and Matheus scored for Athletic. For Arsenal, Cassio scored three goals and Rafael completed the scoreline.

Serie C Matchup

In the final match of the night, in Serie C, Beko defeated Futsal Brasil 5-2. Teves and Vitor Matheus scored for Futsal Brasil. For Beko, Alef Sandro scored twice, while Rafael, Marco Antônio, and Ruan completed the victory.

Next stages of the competition

The competition will continue this Wednesday (2), once again at the Arena gymnasium, with four Serie C matches. Another busy night is expected at the Citadino de Futsal, with teams seeking good results in the continuation of the competition.

With information from Portal Alegrete Tudo, Jornal Minuano.
